description: Return a new object with a property for each [key, value] pair of entries, in order, as ECMAScript Object.fromEntries does; the other half of entries. Each entry must be an array of exactly two entries whose first is a string (it is not converted). When a key appears more than once, the last value wins, as in an object literal.

errorsThrown.reason: an entry is not an array of two, or its key is not a string
